operations.details: Verified official OGC 3D Tiles standard page.
3D streaming capability separated from terrain measurement accuracy.
Renderable content not promoted to bare-earth survey evidence.
Point-cloud transport requires independent classification and vertical-accuracy validation.
Verified official OGC I3S standard page.
Scene-layer delivery separated from authoritative elevation evidence.
Cloud distribution not promoted to source provenance proof.
I3S content rejected as automatic substitute for SHA-bound parcel DTM.
3D Tiles and I3S URLs confirmed absent from prior source registry.
No rendered or streamed 3D value substituted for parcel result.
Canonical manifest untouched; serial publisher required.
